name: Crystal Mote
body:
Price 120,630 gp; Aura strong transmutation; CL 18th; Weight 5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

A crystal mote is a moment of time stolen and shaped into a +1 cunning impervious time-displaced warhammer. In the hands of a chronothurge, the crystal mote’s enhancement bonus increases by +1 for every 4 chronothurge class levels she possesses, to a maximum of +5.

When wielded by a chronothurge, a crystal mote provides spell resistance of 5 + the wielder’s total chronothurge class levels to the wielder and anyone adjacent to her. Once per day, the chronothurge can release the crystal mote as a free action to regain 1 aevum.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells time stop; Cost 60,630 gp; Special creator must have at least 1 aevum. A chronothurge with the time stop aevum qualifies for the Craft Magic Arms and Armor feat using her total chronothurge class levels as her caster level, but only to create a crystal mote and similar, time-centric arms and armor.
